headline: Jefferson win at last after six straight defeats
dek: Jefferson's win over Bryant and Stratton is their first of the season and follows six defeats, more than any other programme has suffered. They have scored ten goals and conceded seventeen.
displaced_by: Jefferson's first win of the season, at home to Bryant and Stratton

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Only Georgian Court have scored more than they have conceded: nineteen for and eleven against, where every other programme is in deficit.

wire.line: Georgian Court have scored more than any other side and are the only programme with more wins than defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Georgian Court's four wins are the most in the conference; they have drawn two matches and lost once.

findings.label: observed
